what: Operator demo on the MOT17-09 upload: confirm only the possible missed crossings that ground truth (checked offline, never shown in the UI) says are real, and record the operator-adjusted count the UI shows.
blur: face-only soft oval (serve.blur mode='face'); the tracker runs on this blurred copy, so the blur changes the tracking result
upload: MOT17-09 (960x540, 525 frames, 30 fps) via Studio step 4 /dashboard/studio/your-video; gate clicked at (0.02, 0.65) -> (0.98, 0.65) of the first frame; ours/visibility_botsort on CPU, YOLOX-S
truth_method: MOT17-09 gt.txt (pedestrians, visible) on the job's gate scaled to 1920x1080, hysteresis scaled the same way; plain crossings matched one-to-one to true ones (same direction, within 15 frames); a suggestion is real if it matches one-to-one a true crossing the plain count missed (same direction, within 15 frames). Script: python -m eval.operator_demo
list_order_in_ui: crossing time (all rows, no cap); pairing score shown as grey text
pair_score: 1 - 0.5*min(1, gap_s/max_gap_s) - 0.5*min(1, distance_rel/max_dist_rel), max_gap_s 4.0, max_dist_rel 2.0 (limits tuned on simulator seeds 0-9)
